notes.content:
Fixes a bunch of UI bugs to display information better. There was a problem with the web server causing turns not to be completed (they should reset every 12 hours), which is now fixed. Quests would not have been resetting for the last 2 weeks because of this. With a low amount of downloads, it's hard to see when things I am not working on break, so if you leave feedback either in the community or discord, please be specific in what is either "broken" or "unstable" as these don't point me to any problems I can fix.

If your queen ever breaks, try using the "Activate Queen" link shown when you click on the crown icon (right side of the UI). It should fix some or most queen related issues by reloading her.

More pvp modes coming soon with Queen Duel and then Magical Chess.

notes.title: Update Notes 8/24
notes.content:
Some big bug fixes. Apparently I added a camera to the game that messed up the queen's movement camera and she wasn't running straight. So big fix there.

Cleaned up some prototype features, such as the banners hanging on your walls or the statues near your east gate, these are both future upgrades. Statues will be unlocked with diamonds and the banners on your walls will be earned by doing activities and provide stat increases. I expect them to be the loot from the dungeon bosses mostly.

Still some crashes in the multiplayer for me, but not in the game version which is what you all are playing. Otherwise it has been smooth for me.

Bug reports are very important for me, since I have limited testing compared to other games. My biggest issue seems to be retesting the entire game to check for things that worked fine the last time I checked it, but break when I add new things. Using discord or the steam community helps, and on discord I can respond to you.

Game releasing to official launch and ending Early Access is any day now, mostly looking for bugs and I will simply change the status one day. Once launched, more players should come from Steam's marketing visibility, which I did not use any of it for early access so we had very few players.

notes.title: First Multiplayer mode added! plus almost 1 full chapter of new content
notes.content:
This update is about twice as big as most updates will be, with almost a full chapter of new tasks unlocked including the first multiplayer mode (Castle Battles). 3 new premium buildings added, these are 3 of the 4 total buildings that can only be upgraded with diamonds.

This new PVP mode is for 2 players, and at this early stage of the game is setup peer to peer which means the player defending the battle also hosts it as the server. In 2 player modes peer networking seems fine, and makes sense that you are actually visiting the defender's kingdom.

Early Access is also about to end, and we will do our official launch in about a week, mostly me waiting for some marketing sources. This game is free and worked on by just myself so I do need your help in getting more players by spreading the word and good reviews.

Expect some bugs in the new content as always when it is first released. I do what I can to fully test it but I can not see all the different types of little (or sometimes big) bugs that happen under normal play. My own play and testing is significantly different than your game experience. Some small code breaks may look much bigger or break the game are often easy to fix once I focus on it.

Known Issues - Multiplayer: (There will be minor updates this week with fixes)
1. Attacker siege weapons - attackers get 2 siege weapons. The X button on keyboard or joystick switches from one to the other. This has a conflict that I am working out, so the 2nd siege isn't used (but appears as it should)

2. Smooth transition in and out of lobbies - This issue is also related to #3 below, and shouldn't be too bad for castle battles, but if you win/lose a match, make sure you have left the last lobby. If you see any timer with a cancel button, that is for the lobby and click cancel if it doesn't disappear automatically.

3. Random queen breaking - there are many different situations this can happen, I generally switch to my king and back to queen to fix it but I'm adding a "Reload Queen" button (next update). It's difficult to detect when it breaks to auto fix it, so while I fix the real bugs that cause the problem, the new button will fix it without needing to reload the game.

4. I have fixed some spell locking issues where it freezes, I was adding a lot of new code to this for multiplayer, and it breaks with the smallest thing, but I added some monitoring of it so the game can fix itself automatically, but I expect to find a few more places to fix before it totally stable. Once stable though, it shouldn't have any more issues for the rest of the game.

Lastly, a note about the game development and what to expect. This update marks about 25% (chapter 5 of 20) of the story content and features. It's easy to assume that means the game is 25% written but programming wise, its closer to 75% written as to make even 1 chapter available requires most of the underlying systems to work. The cutscenes system for example took about 1/3 of total development time so far, but now adding even a long cutscene takes 0 programming. So once we get past a few parts that I literally couldn't test by myself, like the multiplayer, adding future content gets easier and easier reusing the same systems (like monsters, siege, soldiers etc).

notes.title: New Quests, and Alliances feature started.
notes.content:
In this update there are 7 new storyline scenes with a few new quests. The alliances feature is also being introduced, mainly to unlock the "Alliance Chests" quest that is important to gaining free resources faster. When you click a chest on the UI, all alliance members will receive a gift of food, resources, speed up, gold, or alliance coins.

The extra gifts from your alliance members may be buggy at first, as this part is handled by my servers and need people in alliances to fully test it. Alliances are all auto joined, which will be normally the first alliance a new player will see. In future updates you will be able to create, leave and join friends based alliances. There are more alliance features planned but are not needed at this point in the game.

The quest "Summon Creature" has also been added and will join this power of the queen over time. To do this quest a new mini game was added named Memory Match. More land plots also unlocked at the end of chapter 4 included in this update.

The multiplayer is planned for next content update. Please leave feedback on bugs on our discord.

notes.title: AbraTabia Kingdom Released For Early Access!
notes.content:
This game can be played completely free, all content in the game is included for free. There is no marketing for this game yet, so you really be helpful spreading the word and 5 star ratings. I am a solo developer by choice, I guess I wanted to prove I could do it alone and make a legit game.

I have been a solo dev for 25+ years, and I work 7 days a week too. I love what I do and stopped doing pretty much everything else. This was my 3rd game and all 3 games are now built in to this one (Chess and Tribal Council), so I waited a very long time in constant development to feel I had a "real game". I have the development ability to do it but marketing and business wise I need help, or the time to build up. So players are more important than anything else, I'm here to modify it totally around the community now that it is released.

Diamonds buy upgrades that can boost your city management, speed up research or building upgrades and/or customize the design of your castle or players. It is not pay to win, and no PVP stats can be purchased ever.

The game begins with the first 4 chapters, PVP castle battles start in chapter 5. Alliances will be released in the next update, PVP is roughly 2-3 updates away. Early Access should last 30 days. There is no difference in the Early Access version at all. Game is already developed up to around chapter 9, so I have months of updates already ready while I build chapters 9-20.

Planned 10 pvp modes. 5 already built. Castle battles are 1 vs 1, so will start as Peer To Peer. I can switch to servers pretty fast but the game needs to be making the money I need for them, it's too much of a risk with a free game at the start.

Since the game is based on stats, research and building upgrades make a big difference and can be sped up (paid speed up is limited), or a player can have started the game before you. There will be important points in the story (later) that catch all players up to a certain point, to not deter new players from starting the game late.

I do not expect too many bugs in this first 5 chapters, most have been done for a long time now and went through a lot of testing. There are a lot of new things being explained so the story itself isn't too deep yet, and without pvp yet you won't play the game many hours a day. But quests reset every 12 hours, and there are up to 12 per 12 hours. You can also replay any cutscene or fight using the story book icon on the left.

Game Description:
AbraTabia is a magical adventure game where you can build and defend your own kingdom. Grow your citizen population while managing food, gold and resources. Upgrade buildings and research technologies to enhance your soldiers and player character. Army battles with siege weapons and more.

Dramatic open field battles, with up to 300 soldiers on each side. 25 graphical monsters, 9 types of animals for cattle and hunting. 5 types of realistic siege weapons to destroy enemy walls. Dramatic spell effects, and unique player spells. Includes over 100 cutscenes with full audio, lip sync and dynamic camera angles.

Your kingdom's development is built on a storyline system where each page of the story is a short, skippable cutscene and a task assigned to each. Tasks include unlocking buildings, quests, and various battles. You continue to play the game by managing citizen growth, building and research upgrades, flying around your kingdom doing quests, mini games and defending against monster attacks.

- 12 special buildings, 45 player chosen buildings, and 12 research trees.
- Your Queen is the main character with the most powerful magic and evolution over time.
- Daily quests, battles and mini games. Magical monster attacks and fights.
- Upgrading buildings and research will increase your soldier and player strength and abilities.
